model: 15 geriatric-appropriate actives. Differentiation comes from DEDUPE (removing what the user already takes), not from riskier ingredients. Two higher-risk botanicals are hard-gated (auto-excluded) for their risk groups, then substituted or the protocol shortens.

product.format: one mixed sachet per day (pills + capsules)

cap_unit: physical pills per day (sum of units_per_day), not ingredient count
